# Place configure options in the active configure path when upstream moves the owner

381 repairs NSS_EXTRA_SYMBOLS_FILE after upstream configure migration; Bug 1903698 reports missingNSSBase64Decoder_Destroy_Util onMac. Current moz.configure retains imply_option with the comm-relative symbols path. Avoid keeping a setting only in a shell confvars file after the consuming configure option moved. No build or linker validation run; historical error is source-linked cause evidence.

Scope: mail/moz.configure.
